title: PMBOK project plan with documented ChatGPT support
summary: Teams of four or five sixth-semester software engineering students create a detailed project plan covering scope, time, cost, people, communication, risk, and procurement. They use ChatGPT as a reference, identify its contributions, document prompts, responses, and modifications, and defend all artifacts in person.

sources.title: Integrating ChatGPT in Project Management Education: Benefits and Challenges in the Academic Environment

Document AI interactions and defend the work in person.
